events.title: Complete one-step frozen-B2 candidate deck is polynomially enumerable
formal_statement: With V currently available root/extension variables there are at most 2V signed literals.
Every legal next B2 definition has the form e <-> (a AND b), so the ordered candidate deck has size at most 4V^2; under abs(a)!=abs(b) its pre-dedup count is exactly 4V(V-1).
If serialized state size is polynomial in original input N, then the complete one-step candidate deck and syntactic legality scan are polynomial in N.
This does not bound the number of multi-step candidate sequences.
events.next_gap: Replace global candidate-search mystery by a cheap exact progress criterion over the already-polynomial deck.

events.title: Polynomial B2 deck plus cheap exact polynomial-range descent potential would yield a polynomial Akinator
formal_statement: Assume polynomial state, polynomial transition cost, polynomial one-step deck, an exactly polynomial-time computable integer potential 0<=mu(S)<=N^d, universal strict descent from every nonterminal state, and terminal correctness.
Scanning the whole polynomial deck and choosing the first candidate with lower mu is polynomial per step.
Strict integer descent gives at most N^d accepted steps.
Under all assumptions SAT is decidable deterministically in polynomial time, hence P=NP.

events.title: Naive semantic/syntactic global potentials fail
refuted_candidates: free-root count: unchanged by pure B2 extension
clause count / literal volume: basic extension increases them
variable/macro count and next-candidate count: increase under extension
exact model count: conservative definitions preserve it; exact counting is also #P-hard externally
support/globality deficit: can hit zero while formula remains nonterminal
raw F3 width/depth/crossing: lower-bound escape resource, not monotone solver distance
shortest-proof distance treated as free: hides proof search; Resolution automatability is NP-hard externally

active_front.name: U1_E_DERIVATIONAL_RANK
active_front.question: Can a representation-stable, polynomial-range, polynomial-time exact derivational rank be defined so that every nonterminal frozen-B2 state has at least one legal one-step candidate that strictly decreases it, with terminal rank equivalent to exact SAT/UNSAT completion?
